newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aznar to visit Prodi in Italy Sept 10-11.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aznar to visit Prodi in Italy Sept 10-11.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Monday he would meet his Spanish counterpart Jose Maria Aznar for talks in the northern Italian town of Bologna on September 10 and 11.
"Today I had a very long talk with Aznar...we'll meet again on September 10 and 11 to discuss Europe and the Mediterranean," Prodi told reporters.
Prodi met Aznar on Monday for talks ahead of the NATO summit which starts in Madrid on Tuesday.
